purpose: Reusable evidence-linked finding -> correction -> retest -> lesson trail

authorized: engine consultation remediation and explicit assessments
source-to-RAG domain scope and evidence documentation

coverage_statement: All nine known baseline gaps mapped; exhaustive unknown defects not established. Expand after each actual retest.
limitations: Evidence hashes and linked events detect accidental drift; this is not a signed or tamper-proof ledger.
Control validation proves record completeness, not semantic truth or competence.
Owner placeholders require accountable assignment before task closure.
No runtime code or engine behavior is remediated by this control.

mandatory_checkpoints: after each material change or failure
control_contract.enforcement_boundary: Manual execution guard and auditable artifact validation; not automatically hooked into every engine command or CI. Record use at checkpoints.
control_contract.tamper_boundary: Hash continuity plus retained snapshots detect accidental drift; separate signed governance required for trusted attestation.

optimization.measurement_policy: Actual recorded inputs only; missing or historical effort stays null. Counters over retained baseline are not improvement measurements.

metrics.definition: Repeated identical input+engine+context+test with no changed hypothesis
Corrective effort / total recorded effort in the same time/work scope
Actual time from investigation start to reproducible finding
Actual time from finding observation to evidence-backed closure
Newly failing previously passing cases / eligible matched cases
Repeated requests for already supplied decision facts / evaluated requests
Independent whole-case passes / all required whole cases

review_questions: Which failures recur and share root cause?
What was the smallest successful correction and its regressions?
Where did missing evidence, interface assumptions or unclear ownership waste work?
What scope or control prevented a false completion claim?
What lesson should transfer and under what limits?
